units.unitName: Unit 1 How Do You Go There

examples.en: I go to school by bus.

units.unitName: Unit 4 I Have a Pen Pal

examples.en: My pen pal lives in the US.
She wants to be a singer.
I want to be a scientist.
I am afraid of the dark.
I cry because I am sad.
It rains, so I stay home.
examples.zh: 下雨了，所以我待在家里。

examples.en: I am tired, so I sleep.
I am shorter than my brother.
Long ago, there was a king.

examples.zh: 我们度过了美好的一天。

examples.en: The book has a thousand pages.
Beijing has many millions of people.
The garden is full of flowers.
I water flowers on the balcony.
The cat is on the roof.
I live on the third floor.

examples.zh: 每个国家都有自己的文化。

examples.en: I want to be a doctor.
I want to become a teacher.
My goal is to learn English.
